question: How many employees did Nike have at the end of fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: As of May 31, 2025, Nike had approximately 77,800 employees worldwide, including retail and part-time employees.

question: Why did Nike's effective tax rate rise in fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: The effective tax rate rose to 17.1% in fiscal 2025 from 14.9% in fiscal 2024, primarily due to changes in earnings mix, decreased benefits from stock-based compensation and non-recurring one-time benefits in fiscal 2024.

question: What drove the decline in Converse revenues in fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: Converse revenues decreased 18% on a currency-neutral basis, with declines across all territories. Unit sales fell 12% and lower average selling prices, mainly from higher discounts in direct to consumer, reduced revenues by about 6 percentage points.

question: What percentage of Nike's $18 billion share repurchase program had been used by May 31, 2025?
expected_answer: Nike had repurchased about $12.0 billion (122.6 million shares at an average of $98.00) under the $18 billion program, about 66.7% of it, leaving roughly $6.0 billion.

question: How many people did Lululemon employ at the end of fiscal 2024?
expected_answer: As of February 2, 2025, Lululemon employed approximately 39,000 people worldwide.

question: By what percentage did Lululemon's number of company-operated stores grow in 2024?
expected_answer: Company-operated stores rose from 711 to 767, a net increase of 56 stores or about 7.9%.

question: What share of Lululemon's 2024 net revenue came from the Americas?
expected_answer: The Americas generated 75% of Lululemon's total net revenue in 2024.
facts: Americas represented 75% of our total net revenue

question: What happened to Lululemon's MIRROR acquisition?
expected_answer: Lululemon acquired MIRROR in July 2020 and rebranded it as lululemon Studio; in 2023 it stopped selling the hardware and discontinued the digital app-only subscription.

question: How much cash and cash equivalents did Under Armour hold at the end of fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: As of March 31, 2025, Under Armour's cash and cash equivalents totaled $501 million.
facts: cash and cash equivalents totaled $501 million

question: By what percentage did Under Armour's selling, general and administrative expenses change in fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: SG&A rose from $2,400.5 million in fiscal 2024 to $2,602.0 million in fiscal 2025, an increase of $201.5 million or 8.4%.

question: Why did Under Armour's cash flow from operating activities fall in fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: Operating cash flow decreased by $413.3 million, to an outflow of $59.3 million, mainly because net income before non-cash items fell by $455.5 million, partly offset by a $42.2 million increase from changes in working capital.

question: What happened to Under Armour's MapMyFitness platform?
expected_answer: Under Armour sold its MapMyFitness digital platform during the second quarter of fiscal 2025.
facts: sold during the second quarter of Fiscal 2025

question: How many employees did Columbia Sportswear have at the end of 2024?
expected_answer: As of December 31, 2024, Columbia had approximately 9,780 employees: about 5,630 retail, 1,080 distribution center and 3,070 corporate or office employees.

question: By what percentage did Columbia Sportswear's share repurchases increase from 2023 to 2024?
expected_answer: Columbia repurchased $317.8 million of stock in 2024 compared with $184.0 million in 2023, an increase of about 72.7%.

question: What was Columbia Sportswear's effective income tax rate in 2024 compared with 2023?
expected_answer: The effective income tax rate was 25.1% in 2024, up from 22.9% in 2023.

question: How concentrated are Columbia Sportswear's U.S. wholesale customers?
expected_answer: Columbia has over 1,850 U.S. wholesale customers; in 2024 its five largest accounted for approximately 20% of U.S. net sales.
facts: five largest U.S. wholesale customers accounted for approximately 20%

question: How much of Deckers' fiscal 2025 net sales came from its ten largest customers?
expected_answer: Deckers' ten largest customers made up 23.7% of total net sales in fiscal 2025, and no single customer accounted for 10% or more.
facts: ten largest global customers as % of net sales 23.7%

question: By what percentage did Deckers' international net sales grow in fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: International net sales grew from $1,424.1 million to $1,798.9 million, about 26.3%, rising to 36.1% of net sales from 33.2%.

question: What did Deckers do with the Sanuk brand?
expected_answer: Deckers completed the sale of the Sanuk brand and certain related assets on August 15, 2024.

question: What stock split did Deckers carry out in fiscal 2025?
expected_answer: Deckers effected a six-for-one forward stock split on September 13, 2024: each share outstanding on the September 6 record date became six shares, and trading on a split-adjusted basis began on September 17, 2024.
